en.headline: Fire at IVE Tsing Yi campus store room; 400 evacuate, none hurt
en.dek: A store room on the ground floor of the Hong Kong Institute of Vocational Education’s Tsing Yi campus caught fire on Friday morning; firefighters extinguished it quickly and about 400 staff and students left the…
body: A fire broke out in a ground-floor store room at the Hong Kong Institute of Vocational Education (IVE) Tsing Yi campus on Friday morning, prompting about 400 staff and students to evacuate. No one was injured.
Campus staff reported the blaze at about 10.39 am. Firefighters arrived, deployed two breathing-apparatus teams and two hoses, and used a firefighting robot. The flames were put out rapidly.

Investigators believe construction materials in the store room caught fire. Police and fire services said the cause appeared not to be suspicious. Classes and activities were interrupted only briefly while the building was checked.

zh.headline: 青衣IVE雜物房起火 約400師生自行疏散無人傷
zh.dek: 香港專業教育學院青衣分校今早地下雜物房起火，消防迅速救熄，約400名師生自行疏散，無人受傷，起火原因相信無可疑。
body: 今日上午約10時39分，香港專業教育學院（IVE）青衣分校教職員報案，指校內地下一個雜物房起火。消防接報到場，派出兩隊煙帽隊、開動兩條喉灌救，並使用滅火機械人協助，火勢迅速被救熄。
事件中無人受傷，約400名師生自行疏散到安全地方暫避。人員經初步調查後相信，雜物房內有建築物料起火，火警起因沒有可疑。
校方及消防確認現場已恢復正常，師生其後陸續返回校園。
